item.title: Perplexity Computer Adds Multiagent: Up to 16 AI Agents That Cross-Check Work
item.description:
Perplexity added Multiagent to Computer, an effort level above Ultra where a lead agent runs up to 16 agents on Claude, GPT and Gemini models that share findings and check each other’s work.

The post Perplexity Computer Adds Multiagent: Up to 16 AI Agents That Cross-Check Work appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol With a 20% Cheaper Astra API
item.description:
OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol on November 17, 2026. Astra's API price drops 20% to $8/$40 per million tokens, and it ranks second on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index.

The post OpenAI Releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol With a 20% Cheaper Astra API appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Clearing Up the Confusion on AI Data Retention: Two Standard Designs Explained
item.description:
Zero data retention applies to specific AI endpoints, not whole vendors. This guide explains the 2 standard API designs for data retention, who manages deletion in each, and 6 checks for developers.

The post Clearing Up the Confusion on AI Data Retention: Two Standard Designs Explained appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: NVIDIA Open-Sources NVKE and NVKR for Managed Kubernetes on GPU Infrastructure
item.description:
NVIDIA has open-sourced NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE) and NVIDIA Kubernetes Recipes (NVKR) under Apache 2.0. Together they let AI factories run a managed Kubernetes service on their own bare-metal GPU servers. Both are in public preview.

The post NVIDIA Open-Sources NVKE and NVKR for Managed Kubernetes on GPU Infrastructure appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Sarvam Launches Sarvam Token Factory: Bringing India-Hosted Inference to 8 Open Models
item.description:
Sarvam Token Factory is now open to everyone. It serves Sarvam 105B, GLM 5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi K3.1 Pro and Gemma 4 31B from GPU clusters in India through one OpenAI-compatible API.

The post Sarvam Launches Sarvam Token Factory: Bringing India-Hosted Inference to 8 Open Models appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Liquid AI Releases d1.2 and d1.2-ultra: Omnimodal Decision Models That Top the AA Decision Index
item.description:
Liquid AI released d1.2 and d1.2-ultra, decision models that read text, images and audio and return calibrated probabilities with zero output tokens. d1.2-ultra scores 75 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index v2.1.

The post Liquid AI Releases d1.2 and d1.2-ultra: Omnimodal Decision Models That Top the AA Decision Index appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Meet Meta’s JiTTests: LLM-Generated Tests Designed to Fail Before Risky Code Lands
item.description:
Meta has moved Catching JiTTests into production. The LLM system writes tests designed to fail on risky diffs, and caught 74 privacy SEVs before landing in H1 2026, with a 60% engineer-reported true-positive rate.

The post Meet Meta’s JiTTests: LLM-Generated Tests Designed to Fail Before Risky Code Lands appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Alibaba Releases Qwen4-Max: 2.4T MoE, 71B Active, 1M Context
item.description:
Alibaba released Qwen4-Max, a proprietary 2.4T-parameter MoE model with 71B active parameters, native vision and a 1M-token context. It costs $1.5/M input tokens and cuts Work360 cost per task by 62%.

The post Alibaba Releases Qwen4-Max: 2.4T MoE, 71B Active, 1M Context appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Hark Releases Handoff², a 2x Faster Computer-Use Agent for Hark Pro
item.description:
Hark has released Handoff², the computer-use agent inside Hark Pro. It averages 2x faster than v1, completes 82% of 478 internal web tasks, and learned to batch actions through latency-penalized RL.

The post Hark Releases Handoff², a 2x Faster Computer-Use Agent for Hark Pro appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Bland Launches Tofu-1, a Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Model for Calls
item.description:
Bland has released Tofu-1, a full-duplex speech-to-speech model for noisy, high-stakes phone calls. It is in enterprise research preview, with no published benchmarks, size or pricing yet.

The post Bland Launches Tofu-1, a Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Model for Calls appeared first on MarkTechPost.
